mentions.name: Motorbike RF lightning detector
mentions.description: A compact RF lightning detector small enough to be trivially added to a motorbike, intended to warn the rider of nearby storms; if successful, the PCB designs will be published.
mentions.problem: Storms in Viet Nam arrive fast and are local enough that weather prediction is not very useful, and driving through bad storms is miserable; heavy EMI from ungrounded brushed motors makes the RF detection difficult.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm trying to make an RF lightning detector small enough to trivially add to my motorbike.

evidence.value: I'm trying to make an RF lightning detector small enough to trivially add to my motorbike.
